title: Decode: DSA attention path (q path, sparse MLA, DCP value, indexer)
shape: D3-32 r24 1-node DP-rank slice, NVFP4 ckpt (k31-nvfp4-view-L24: 6 DSA layers), 384 verify rows/rank, u132k, k=3; family = DSA q path + sparse MLA + DCP value + prologue + indexer logits, in-step exposed
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 slice (INFRA measured/20261118-1900-nvfp4-decode.json, r24: q_path 0.295 + sparse_mla 0.198 + dcp_value 0.156 + prologue 0.025 + idx_score 0.235 ms exposed); achievable = nvfp4_modelopt L24 rows (0.249 + 0.106). r8 0.458 vs 0.149, r16 0.800 vs 0.252.
gap_analysis: NVFP4 slice r24, per DSA layer (6 layers): q path 49 us exposed (98 busy: MlaQuery side stream + QueryWait spin) vs 22 ach; trtllm-gen sparse MLA 33 vs 9.7; DcpValue 26 vs 9.7; indexer logits 39 exposed (68 busy) vs 17.7. SOL designs: (1) q path: LocalQuery (no publish/QueryWait) then a fused tcgen05 q_b->W_UK->FP8 kernel, bound by the 96-head q_b + W_UK weight stream; (2) sparse MLA: native kernel, bound by the per-row KV gather (384 rows x ~512 local keys x 576 B = 113 MB/layer at ~13-18 TB/s = 6.3-8.7 us; MMA 2.3K+1K clk per row-CTA with Q and P in TMEM is below it), projected ~9-10 us; (3) joint 4-row indexer: one M128 (4 rows x 32 heads) block-scaled MMA per key tile, keys streamed once per request (~218 MB/rank at HBM ~15.6 us) vs DeepGEMM's per-row streams; (4) DcpValue: W_UV in the sparse kernel epilogue + one-round multicast push.
inefficiencies: MlaQuery: per-head 8-CTA cluster tiling, cluster-round bound (measured linear 0.18 us/row standalone) -> replaced by LocalQuery from 65 rows
P6 q publish + QueryWait cross-rank poll + DcpValue q-mailbox re-arm (R x 96 x 576 B sentinel stores/layer) -> removed on local rows
LocalQuery GEMMs: cuBLAS q_b N=18432 at 1.2 PF (R384) and W_UK bmm 13 us; untuned split-K q_b below 65 rows (D-GEMM tactic item)
Sparse MLA trtllm-gen: ~20 us fixed + 0.055 us/row, 128 padded heads; measured not BW/MMA bound (dedup alone does not help)
DcpValue proj: 25 us vs ~9 model (P7b push + W_UV + LSE merge)
Indexer logits: SM100 DeepGEMM paged logits runs the varlen next_n=1 form (one row per task), so a request 4 verify rows each stream its keys (L2 absorbs part: 2.2x model, not 4x)
rubin_features: tcgen05 UMMA (FP8 / block-scaled MXFP4) with TMEM accumulators
TMA gather4 for paged KV / index-key row gathers
NVLink multicast only where a push beats local recompute
plan: DONE LocalQuery (wzhao/k31ws-d-attn 72fdf53350); NVFP4 in-step A/B r8/r16/r24 running (overlay dattn-nv-8befd4a-1 = INFRA NVFP4 baseline content + LocalQuery)

Native sparse MLA decode (dsa/sparse_mla.py): 2-CTA cluster per row (V halves), gather4 multicast of 128-key tiles, Q and P in TMEM (.ts MMAs), exact running-max E4M3 P like trtllm-gen; target <= 10 us/layer at r24 (bench_dattn_sparse_native.py)
Joint 4-row indexer logits kernel (M128 = 4 rows x 32 heads, keys once per request)
DcpValue: fold W_UV + push into the sparse kernel epilogue
q path: fused tcgen05 q_b -> W_UK -> FP8 (no BF16 latent round trip)
